instruction: Fold the T-shirt, starting with the sleeves being folded first, then the T-shirt is folded from the bottom upwards until it is finally folded into a small rectangle.
expanded_instruction: Fold the T-shirt, starting with the sleeves being folded first, then the T-shirt is folded from the bottom upwards until it is finally folded into a small rectangle.
Fold the T-shirt in half, aligning the sleeves and the bottom of the T-shirt.
Fold the sleeves of the T-shirt towards the center of the T-shirt.
Fold the T-shirt in half again, aligning the sleeves and the bottom of the T-shirt.
Fold the T-shirt in half one more time, aligning the sleeves and the bottom of the T-shirt.
Fold the T-shirt in half one last time, aligning the sleeves and the bottom of the T-shirt.
Fold the T-shirt into a small rectangle.
